## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `POST /api/v1/anonymous-user` — Create an anonymous user for authentication.

### Data Read (6)
- `GET /attribution_trigger` — Trigger attribution tracking.
- `GET /compose/web_widget/sportsrecruits.zendesk.com` — Retrieve Zendesk widget configuration.
- `GET /gvl/eu/vendor-list.json` — Download the EU vendor list.
- `GET /integrations/veo` — Retrieve Veo integration data.
- `GET /livechat-public/v1/message/public` — Retrieve public live chat messages.
- `GET /web/v3/ip` — Get the user's IP address.

### Data Write (3)

- `POST /wa/` — Send data to a webhook.
- `POST /web/v3/consent/img_academy/{img_academyId}` — Submit user consent for IMG Academy.

### Config (2)

- `GET /web/v3/config/img_academy/sportsrecruits_com/production/usgeneral/en/config.json` — Get the application configuration.
